# DismissController

> Manages a dismiss layer that dispatches `ui-dismiss` on outside click or Escape.

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `enable()` |
| `disable()` |
| `destroy()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { DismissController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new DismissController(element);
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
